questions.q: Complete: L'année prochaine, je vais ___ Canada.
questions.why: Masculine countries take au; feminine take en; plural take aux.
False friend: le car = coach; a car is la voiture.

questions.q: How do you say 'My mother is a nurse'?
questions.why: No article with a job after être, and the feminine form is infirmière.
